setup.clone.title: Clone Repository
setup.conventions.title: Conventions: {{name}}
setup.conventions.empty: No conventions yet. Add project-specific rules below.
setup.focus.title: Keep what you're working on in one place
setup.focus.description: Focus adds a group to the top of the sidebar with the threads you're actively working on, from every project: ones that are running, or were active in the last {{window}}.
setup.focus.threadCount_one: Shows {{count}} thread before "Show more" — right-click Focus to change that. You can turn it off or change the time in Settings.
setup.focus.threadCount_other: Shows {{count}} threads before "Show more" — right-click Focus to change that. You can turn it off or change the time in Settings.
setup.newProject.title: New Project
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to agmux
setup.welcome.upgradeDescription: A few new choices — project memory, agent permissions, phone remote, and alerts. Skip anytime.
setup.welcome.description: Choose an agent, review permissions, and open your first project. You can customize appearance and add local models later in Settings.
setup.providers.title: Agent Providers
setup.providers.description: We checked Claude Code and Codex on your system. Grok, Cursor, Kimi, OpenCode, and local models can be used later from the New menu when their tools are installed.
setup.providers.helpDescription: Installed means the tool was found, not that you are signed in. Follow your agent’s setup guide, then launch {{claude}} or {{codex}} in Terminal and finish sign-in. Your first conversation confirms the connection.
setup.appearance.title: Appearance
setup.appearance.description: Pick a color mode and theme. Glass surfaces reflect your desktop wallpaper.
setup.appearance.theme.violet-haze.label: Violet
setup.appearance.theme.rose-quartz.label: Rose
setup.appearance.theme.neon-noir.label: Noir
setup.appearance.theme.mocha-latte.label: Mocha
setup.appearance.theme.slate-steel.label: Steel
setup.appearance.theme.custom.label: Custom
setup.typography.title: Fonts
setup.typography.description: Choose typefaces for the interface and for code. Changes apply immediately.
setup.typography.sampleText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
setup.layout.title: Session layout
setup.layout.description: How projects and agent sessions are arranged. You can switch anytime in Settings → Appearance.
setup.layout.verticalDescription: Classic left sidebar with project groups
setup.defaults.title: Defaults
setup.defaults.description: What new sessions start as, how they open, and which AI drafts commit messages.
setup.defaults.quickOpenDescription: What the compose button and ⌘N create.
setup.defaults.commitMessageDescription: AI used to draft commit subjects. Auto tries Codex Spark, then Grok 4.5, then Claude Haiku.
setup.agents.title: Agents & memory
setup.agents.description: How agents share context across chats, and whether new sessions run tools without asking.
setup.agents.projectMemoryDescription: Share facts and decisions across every agent in a project. Agents get memory tools so they remember what you decided. Recommended on.
setup.agents.recentSessionIndexDescripti: When memory is on, new chats get a short list of recent titles (previews only — never full logs) so agents know prior work exists.
setup.agents.fullPermissionsDescription: Start every new chat with full permissions so shell, edit, and write tools run without asking. Only enable on machines and projects you trust.
setup.connect.title: Phone, alerts & updates
setup.connect.description: Control from your phone, get notified when agents need you, and keep the app current.
setup.connect.phoneRemoteDescription: Let a phone at remote.agmux.dev manage chats on this Mac. Pair in Settings → Remote after setup. Off by default for safety.
setup.connect.notifyCompleteDescription: macOS notification when a chat finishes in the background.
setup.connect.notifyApprovalDescription: Alert when an agent is waiting for you to approve a tool or answer a question.
setup.connect.keepAwake: Keep Mac awake while agents run
setup.connect.keepAwakeDescription: Prevent sleep while any agent is working or waiting for approval. Useful for long runs and phone remote.
setup.connect.automaticUpdatesDescriptio: Download and install app updates when you open agmux, without an extra click.
setup.localModel.title: Local AI model
setup.localModel.description: Required. agmux downloads a small on-device model for offline thread naming and quick tasks — one-time download, no API key after setup.
setup.localModel.offlineNote: No API key after download. Works offline. ~1–2 GB disk.
setup.localModel.retired: Your current model ({{model}}) is retired. Pick one below to keep automatic titles and summaries working.
setup.complete.title: Start your first conversation
setup.complete.upgradeDescription: New preferences are saved. Tweak anything later in Settings ({{shortcut}}).
setup.complete.description: Open a project folder below, then send a first prompt such as “Explain this project without changing files.” If sign-in is needed, your agent will guide you. Appearance, local models and other options remain in Settings ({{shortcut}}).
